deadNavLinks.description: Real, structurally unusual fact: Navbar dropdown menus (src/components/navbar/menus.js) link to /secondary-vehicles and /control-os, neither of which has a matching entry in src/pages/routes.jsx or src/App.jsx. These are DIFFERENT from the /careers and /customers dummy stubs — those two got real Placeholder routes; these two did not. Clicking them in the live clone would fall through to React Router's unmatched-route behavior (no explicit 404 route was found in routes.jsx either). Documented here per BUILD-GUIDE.md 'note anything structurally unusual' — not modeled as a generatable page in templates.json, and not corrected in this design-repo since it accurately reflects the real, current state of the cloned source.

signupPageExclusion.description: The /get-started (alias /setup) SignUp page is INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED from templates/templates.json and tokens/00-foundation/color.json. It clones a different, real application (app.rollups.com/setup — Rails + Bootstrap backend, AngelList/Inter-family fonts, white background, teal/indigo palette), mounted in src/App.jsx as a sibling <Route> with no shared Navbar/Footer/CookieBar. Merging its tokens into the marketing-site's dark-green palette would misrepresent both systems as one. Its evidence lives in tokens/00-foundation/color.signup.json (documentation-only, not wired into schema/compatibility/allowlist) and is cited from CLONE_SPEC_SIGNUP.md in full.

contentAuthenticity.description: Per CLONE_SPEC_CONTENT.md, blog article bodies, legal document bodies, some long FAQ answers, and some option-card descriptions in this SOURCE PROJECT are placeholder/generic text written to match the ORIGINAL rollups.com site's structural shape (paragraph counts, word counts, heading counts) — they are NOT rollups.com's actual live copy. Headings, titles, dates, authors, excerpts, stat numbers, and short labels/CTAs ARE real/verbatim, per src/data/articles.js's own header comment ('Titles, excerpts, meta and every heading are verbatim... the prose itself is placeholder copy'). maxWords budgets in this design-repo are grounded in the real structural shape (accurate), not in the placeholder wording (not literal brand copy). A generator using this design-repo should treat long-form body-copy examples in components/article-body-block.json and sections/legal-body.json as structural demonstrations only.
